sourceTitle: Time's Portraiture (From: "The Doliver Romance and Other Pieces: Tales and Sketches")
description: "Time's Portraiture" by Nathaniel Hawthorne is a prose piece that serves as the Carrier's Address to the patrons of "The Salem Gazette" for January 1, 1838. Written during the early to mid-19th century, this work reflects a blend of social commentary and poetic musings, centering on the theme of time and its impact on human life.
